title: Jithan
desc: Surya, who leads a tough life at home, loves Priya who barely acknowledges him. Things take a turn when Surya gets the power to become invisible.

title: Mounam Pesiyadhe
desc: Gautam, uninterested in romance, slowly finds his world shifting when Sandhya enters his life, but before he understands his feelings, family decisions complicate matters.

title: Kaalam Maripochu
desc: Sadagopan hurriedly marries his three daughters off to unworthy suitors as he views them as liabilities. But when disputes arise within the family, his views are questioned.

title: Aayirathil Oruvan
desc: When a reputed archaeologist, Chandramouli, disappears from his research expedition, his daughter, Lavanya, teams up with a government official, Anitha, to find him.

title: Maruthu
desc: Maruthu falls in love with Bhagyalakshmi. He finds out that her mother was assassinated by a corrupt politician and sets out to avenge her death.
